data_roles.state_history: Big5 2014-2022 completed league history strictly before target calendar date snapshot

feature.definition: For each team, aggregate nonpenalty xG by player_id across its latest 8 completed same-league matches available strictly before the target calendar date. Team HHI is sum((player_npxg/total_team_npxg)^2). Match feature is the arithmetic mean of home and away team HHI.
feature.interpretation: Higher values mean recent nonpenalty chance quality is carried by a smaller set of shooters; lower values mean responsibility is distributed across more players.

method.model: offset logistic on Frozen Stage6 B draw probability
method.missing_feature_policy: z=0 after train-only standardization; coverage hard gate remains 0.98
method.score_matrix_rule: region-rescale Frozen Stage6 B score matrix to candidate 1X2 while preserving within-result-region shape

nonduplication.shot_profile_matchup_residual: Consumed shot-profile routes aggregate location/quality/timing/shot-type distributions. This feature instead partitions team xG by shooter identity and measures concentration of player responsibility.
nonduplication.r43o1_specialist_gk_finishing_state: R43O1 uses player finishing/GK/penalty specialist priors from player technical state; this candidate uses only strictly prior Understat nonpenalty xG shares by shooter identity and no player rating/finishing conversion state.
nonduplication.r45b_player_capability: R45B uses strictly prior player capability attributes and expected-XI construction; this candidate uses no lineup or player attributes, only realized prior nonpenalty xG responsibility concentration.
nonduplication.lineup_pair_network: Lineup pair-network mechanisms concern co-appearance/lineup connectivity; this feature is a scalar concentration of chance-quality responsibility, independent of lineup co-occurrence edges.

after_pass.next: find and preregister a genuinely unconsumed historical confirmation cohort before label scoring
